lead_post.text:
https://t.co/OItLjTT3Ai’S $2.5 BILLION EUROPEAN SHOPPING SPREE JUST HIT A WALL

China’s https://t.co/FCHDrFZdP9 is facing serious resistance over its proposed $2.5 billion acquisition of German electronics retailer Ceconomy.

The deal would give https://t.co/FCHDrFZdP9 control of MediaMarktSaturn, one of Europe’s biggest consumer-electronics retailers.

But European competitors are pushing back.

The European Commission is reviewing the transaction under its Foreign Subsidies Regulation.

That matters because regulators are investigating whether https://t.co/FCHDrFZdP9 benefited from preferential financing, tax incentives or government grants linked to Beijing.

https://t.co/FCHDrFZdP9 has already offered concessions.

It proposed giving Ceconomy and smaller European competitors access to its logistics and technology infrastructure at market-based prices.

But rivals have reportedly criticized those concessions as insufficient.

Now https://t.co/FCHDrFZdP9 may have to offer even more to get the deal approved.

The deadline is October 23.

The stakes are much bigger than one German retailer.

https://t.co/FCHDrFZdP9 is trying to build a European distribution network that combines e-commerce, warehouses, logistics and physical retail.

Ceconomy operates hundreds of MediaMarkt and Saturn stores across Europe.

For JD com, the acquisition would provide an instant physical footprint in one of the world's wealthiest consumer markets.

For European regulators, the question is whether a Chinese company with potential state-linked advantages should be allowed to acquire a major European retail platform.

This is exactly the kind of transaction that could become much harder for Chinese companies to complete in Europe.

The $2.5 billion deal is no longer simply about buying a retailer.

It has become a test of how Europe treats Chinese capital, subsidies and strategic acquisitions.

lead_post.translation_zh:
JD.com 25亿美元的欧洲大采购刚刚撞墙

中国的 JD.com 正因其拟以25亿美元收购德国电子产品零售商 Ceconomy 而面临严重阻力。

这笔交易将使 JD.com 控制 MediaMarktSaturn，后者是欧洲最大的消费电子产品零售商之一。

但欧洲竞争对手正在反击。

欧盟委员会正在根据其《外国补贴条例》审查这笔交易。

这很重要，因为监管机构正在调查 JD.com 是否受益于与北京方面有关的优惠融资、税收激励或政府补助。

JD.com 已经提出了让步。

它提议以市场化价格向 Ceconomy 和规模较小的欧洲竞争对手开放其物流和技术基础设施。

但据报道，竞争对手批评这些让步不够充分。

现在 JD.com 可能不得不提出更多让步，才能让这笔交易获批。

截止日期是10月23日。

利害关系远不止一家德国零售商。

JD.com 正试图建立一个结合电商、仓库、物流和实体零售的欧洲分销网络。

Ceconomy 在欧洲各地经营着数百家 MediaMarkt 和 Saturn 门店。

对于 JD com 来说，这次收购将使其在全球最富裕的消费市场之一立即获得实体布局。

对于欧洲监管机构来说，问题在于，一家可能拥有国家相关优势的中国公司是否应被允许收购一个主要的欧洲零售平台。

这正是那种可能会让中国公司在欧洲更难完成的交易。

这笔25亿美元的交易不再只是关于收购一家零售商。

它已经成为欧洲如何对待中国资本、补贴和战略性收购的一场考验。
